inferred_conclusions.conclusion: The exact maintenance head is ready for GitHub CI and merge because its owner boundaries, regressions, runtime integrity bindings, and user-data exclusions are deterministically verified.

observed_facts.fact: The focused ownership matrix and verifier pass for the Diagnostics duplicate-removal, handoff clipboard-success handling, and regenerated runtime integrity identities.
